The '''KVT-Series 400 fanjet''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engine designed and produced by [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
The KVT-Series 400 was a type of high-thrust fanjet engine designed by Keizar-Volvec for use in their [[9T9-B Wasp/Legends|KV9T9-B Wasp]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]]. A pair of these engines were equipped with a sophisticated control system that allowed the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] to take full advantage of their ample thrust power.<ref name="EV" />
